provenance.range-slider-is-real: RESOLVES THE ORCHESTRATOR'S SCOPING QUESTION DIRECTLY: `packages/core/src/slider/RangeSlider.tsx` is a full, independent, exported component (197 lines, its OWN `RangeSliderProps` interface with `value: [number,number]`, `startName`/`endName`, `onChange(event, [number,number])`) — not a thin wrapper or a stories-only example. provenance.width-is-fixed-not-selectable: SliderThumb.css `.saltSliderThumb { width: var(--salt-size-fixed-200) }` = 2px, a FIXED (density-INVARIANT) literal — CONFIRMED by reading the CSS directly, re-checked twice because every prior Salt selectable control (checkbox's box, switch's thumb, radio's dot) sizes BOTH dimensions from `--salt-size-selectable`; slider's own thumb only borrows that token for HEIGHT, and hardcodes WIDTH to the same fixed-scale token every other column's own BORDER width uses. The thumb is a narrow, height-scaling, width-FIXED bar — not a square/circle that scales uniformly.
provenance.byDensity.tick-height: SliderTrack.css `--slider-tick-height: calc((var(--salt-size-selectable) - var(--salt-size-bar)) / 2)`. Computed per density: high (12-2)/2=5, medium (14-4)/2=5, low (16-6)/2=5, touch (18-8)/2=5 — A GENUINE ARITHMETIC COINCIDENCE: `size-selectable - size-bar` is a CONSTANT 10px across all four densities in the current token set (12-2=10, 14-4=10, 16-6=10, 18-8=10), so despite being expressed as a density-relative calc(), tick-height resolves to the IDENTICAL 5px at every density — verified by computing all four by hand, not assumed from the formula's shape.
provenance.byDensity.root-gap: SliderTrack.css `.saltSliderTrack-container { gap: var(--salt-spacing-100) }` -> foundations/spacing.css, DENSITY scale 4/8/12/16px — the SAME token AND numbers every prior Salt column's own root-gap slot used.
provenance.byDensity.label-fontSize/label-lineHeigh: SliderTrack.css's `<Text styleAs="label">` -> next/characteristics/text.css, the LABEL role (a DIFFERENT role from every prior Salt column's own BODY role) — DENSITY scale 10/13 (high) . 11/14 (medium) . 12/16 (low) . 14/18 (touch), read directly from the four `.salt-density-*` blocks.
provenance.no-readonly: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, grepped directly: neither `SliderProps` nor `RangeSliderProps` declares a `readOnly`/`readonly` field anywhere, unlike Salt's own Checkbox/Switch/RadioButton, which all have one — the FIRST Salt column in this pipeline where a sibling selectable-control capability is genuinely, uniformly missing rather than partially present.
provenance.keyboard-is-js-override: `useSliderThumb.ts`'s own `handleKeydownOnThumb` calls `getKeyboardValue` (utils.ts) and manually dispatches a synthetic input-change — a JS override of the native range input's own free keyboard semantics, done SPECIFICALLY so `stepMultiplier`/`restrictToMarks`/`marks` can be supported (none of which a native browser knows about). `getKeyboardValue` reproduces Arrow(±step)/Home(min)/End(max)/PageUp/PageDown(±step*stepMultiplier) — the SAME keys the native input already answers, just recomputed in JS.
provenance.bounds-doc-vs-code-mismatch: `SliderProps.max`'s own JSDoc reads `@default 10`, but `Slider.tsx`'s ACTUAL destructuring default is `max = 100` — a real, sourced STALE-DOC finding, confirmed by reading the destructuring statement directly rather than trusting the comment above it. `min = 0` is consistent in both the doc and the code.
provenance.no-pressed-color: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: `SliderThumb.css` has no colour-changing `:active` rule; the ONLY `:active`-scoped rule anywhere in the file is `.saltSliderThumb:active, .saltSliderThumb-dragging { cursor: var(--salt-cursor-grab-active) }` — cursor only.

structure.track.source: SliderTrack.tsx <div className=saltSliderTrack-rail>; two-tone look drawn via ::before/::after in SliderTrack.css

structure.fill.value: pseudo-element in single mode; a REAL <div className=saltSliderTrack-fill> ONLY when isRange

structure.thumb.value: a 2px-wide fixed-width bar, height scales by density
structure.thumb.source: SliderThumb.css .saltSliderThumb { width: var(--salt-size-fixed-200); height: var(--salt-size-selectable) } — see width-is-fixed-not-selectable

structure.value-readout.source: SliderTooltip, visibility toggled via a JS-timed hover/drag/focus state, DEFAULT ON (showTooltip=true)

structure.ticks.source: SliderTrack.tsx: {marks && showTicks && <div className=saltSliderTrack-ticks>...}, opt-in, DEFAULT FALSE (showTicks unset)

behavior.role.value: implicit, free from the native <input type="range">
behavior.role.source: no explicit role attribute anywhere in SliderThumb.tsx

behavior.value-announcement.value: aria-valuenow/aria-valuetext set EXPLICITLY on the input despite being implicit from a native range input already

behavior.keyboard-value-change.value: a JS OVERRIDE reproducing native Arrow/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown semantics, done so restrictToMarks/marks/stepMultiplier can be supported

behavior.pointer-drag.value: fully JS-driven — handlePointerMove recomputes the value from clientX on every window pointermove while dragging

behavior.track-click-jump.value: explicit JS — handlePointerDownOnTrack computes a value from the click position and jumps the thumb
behavior.track-click-jump.source: useSliderThumb.ts handlePointerDownOnTrack, wired to SliderTrack's onPointerDown

behavior.value-readout-visibility.value: shown on pointer-hover (300ms-delayed hide via setTimeout), on drag, or on keyboard focus-visible; opt-OUT via showTooltip

behavior.disabled-handling.value: const disabled = formFieldDisabled || disabledProp (ancestor FormField merge, no group construct — Slider has none); .saltSliderTrack-disabled sets pointer-events:none on the wrapper

behavior.form-participation.value: native — the input(s) ARE the real form control(s); range mode submits TWO separately-named inputs (startName/endName)

prop.value-shape.value: two separate exported components: Slider (value:number) and RangeSlider (value:[number,number]), sharing SliderTrack/SliderThumb internals

prop.range.note: capability list — reached by choosing RangeSlider over Slider, not a prop on one component; this chassis's own config axis unifies both into one shared boolean

prop.bounds.note: min=0/max=100 per the ACTUAL destructuring default in Slider.tsx — see bounds-doc-vs-code-mismatch for the stale @default 10 JSDoc

prop.step-multiplier.source: Slider.tsx destructured default: stepMultiplier = 2, used by getKeyboardValue for PageUp/PageDown

prop.disabled.source: SliderProps.disabled?: boolean, merged with the ancestor FormField's

prop.value-format.value: a format?: (value:number) => string|number CALLBACK, applied to the tooltip text, min/max labels, and aria-valuetext

prop.restrict-to-marks.source: SliderProps.restrictToMarks?: boolean, DEFAULT FALSE — when true, step is IGNORED and the value snaps to the nearest marks[].value (utils.ts clamp)

slot.min-label.value: minLabel?: string, falls back to format?.(min)

slot.max-label.value: maxLabel?: string, falls back to format?.(max)

slot.composes.note: form-field (useFormFieldProps() pulls disabled/aria-labelledby down from an ancestor <FormField>); the .saltSliderTrack-marks value-legend is declared OUT OF SCOPE, see structure.ticks

state.rest.value: a semi-transparent (50% alpha) neutral track, an accent-filled 2px-wide thumb bar
state.rest.note: genuinely different from every other Salt column's own opaque neutral tokens — see track-bg provenance

state.hover.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE for colour — no dedicated :hover rule in SliderThumb.css beyond the cursor change (style.thumb.cursor); the wrapper's own cursor:hover is the only rest/hover distinction

state.focus.value: the shared --salt-focused-* outline family (2px dotted, 1px offset) on .saltSliderThumb-focusVisible

state.pressed.value: cursor-only — grab becomes grab-active; NO colour change
